name: Robben Island Lighthouse
scope: Separately research the lighthouse on Minto Hill and its exact anchor. Do not place it at the island story reference point.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

placements.title: Robben Island Lighthouse
placements.note: Local Qualla batch preview: the round lighthouse on Minto Hill, separately anchored from the island story; office and engine room excluded. Source qa.json records completed visual and geographic review when available.

references.caption: Robben Island Lighthouse  /  Jan van Riebeeck first set a navigation aid atop the highest point on the island. Huge bonfires were lit at night to warn ships of the rocks that surround the island. The current lighthouse was built 1864 and  converted to electricity in 1938.  It is the only South African lighthouse to utilise a flashing light instead of a revolving light and is visible for 24 nautical miles.
references.artist: Harvey Barrison from Massapequa, NY, USA

review.method: Inspected local original-image contact sheets; replaced unrelated images and insufficient detail views. Acceptance permits authored exterior work, not geographic activation.
review.notes: Visible exterior geometry is useful. Unseen sides require conservative reconstruction and standard viewer map controls.
